pageTitle: Public toilets and drinking water in Rome
metaDescription: 8,319 practical places mapped in Rome: 259 public toilets, 2,109 drinking water points, 1,306 places to park. Free on iOS and Android.
heroTitle: Public toilets and drinking water in Rome
heroLead: Voyager Maps has 8,319 practical places mapped in Rome — the things you actually need while travelling, rather than restaurants and directions.
statsIntro: How many of each kind of place the map currently holds in Rome. These are mapped locations, not an estimate of every one that exists — coverage comes from OpenStreetMap and grows as people add to it.
ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in Rome on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Rome
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Rome it currently holds 259 public toilets and 2,109 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: Rome is a city to carry a bottle in: it has 8.1 times more public drinking water points than public toilets — 2,109 against 259.
